$description: Values are what disciple.tools renders (theme disciple-tools-public-site plus Elementor page CSS). Colour names follow the site's own: $medium-blue-color / primary → blue, $green-color → green.

background.$description: Page background and the testimonial cards. The site renders #FEFEFE, folded into white.

text.$description: Body text, image-box titles, footer column headings. The near-black also used for the quote icon (#212121 on the site) and pasted copy (#333).

blue.$description: The brand blue ($medium-blue-color, primary). Headings, links, buttons, title bands, the copyright bar.

green.$description: The brand green ($green-color, theme-color). The logo mark, Get Started and Demo buttons, green bands, feature icons.

sky.$description: Hover and open background of nav menu items. Used nowhere else.

blue-tint.$description: Background of the note callout (.dt-note): #90B4D0 at 40%.

grey-lightest.$description: Light sections: the partner-logo strip, the footer menu, testimonial section on some pages.

grey-lighter.$description: Text on blue bands, dividers, striped table rows (the site's #F1F1F1 folded in).

grey-light.$description: The icon-grid section background and the rules between feature-list rows.

grey.$description: Form field borders, the dropdown menu border and the focus glow (the site's #CACACA/#CCCCCC folded in).

grey-dark.$description: The 1px rule under the nav bar.

white.$description: Text on blue and green, button labels.

media.$description: App screenshots in the feature list.

body.$description: Everything except headings: body, buttons, nav, footer, forms. Also the page title (h1).

heading.$description: Section headings (h2–h5), the statement band, step numbers.

regular.$description: Body, nav links, form labels, step descriptions.

semibold.$description: Open Sans: the heading on green statement bands.

strong.$description: Buttons, links, table headers, image-box titles (h4, h5).

heavy.$description: Every section heading (Open Sans) and the page title (Roboto).

base.$description: Everything else at body size; h4; multi-line statement headings.

heading.$description: Section headings (32px on 32px), buttons, step numbers.

page-title.$description: The page title (h1). The tall line box is what spaces it from the content below.

body.$description: 16px. Body, nav, links, footer, md buttons, fields.

h4.$description: 20.8px. Image-box titles, link-band column headings, step descriptions.

icon.$description: 30px. The quote icon on testimonial cards.

field.$description: 39px. Height of text fields and selects.

logo.$description: Height of the logo in the nav bar.

nav.$description: Width of the nav bar's content.

sm.$description: Default: buttons, fields, the Demo button, tables.

xxxs.$description: Icon to text in icon lists.

xxs.$description: Column padding (the container gutter), table cells, the note callout.

xs.$description: Between widgets (the flow default), statement band padding, gap between stacked buttons.

s.$description: Card padding, padding of green and grey bands.

m.$description: Partner-logo strip padding; large button padding-x.

l.$description: Top padding of feature rows and the steps band.

xl.$description: Padding of the tallest sections (testimonial intro).

button-y.$description: Default button padding top and bottom.

button-x.$description: Default button padding left and right.

button-md.$description: Medium button padding top and bottom (left and right is s).

submit.$description: Form submit button padding, all sides.

nav-y.$description: Nav link padding top and bottom.

nav-x.$description: Nav link padding left; Demo button padding left and right.

button-nav.$description: Demo button padding top and bottom.

footer.$description: Space above the footer menu columns.

band.$description: Title band padding top and bottom (82px tall with a 32px heading). Card padding below 768px.
